arStrings.szText: "Drowned in pursuit!” he hollers. “They’ve learned to sail!”

That’s what I says, I says “Give me that!” And I look through the scope. But there it is—one rowboat, no sails, and in the middle of it, one of them slimy looking Drowned bastards, rowing like his life depends on it.

And we crowd around the stern, and he gets closer, and—(snort)—it’s, it’s—ha! It’s no Drowned at all, it’s that drunkard Bion! All caked in shite, ‘cause he got too sloshed the night before and tumbled straight into the latrine! (wheezing laughter)
